title: Determination of the Fee Placed on a Granite Ridge Pass Account for a Carry-Forward Election
content:
A holder who carries a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass forward to the following season has a fee placed on the pass account for the election, and this rule fixes that fee.

**The fee base.** The fee base is the carry-forward fee the tier carries.

**The protection share.** The fee base is taken in full whatever protection the household holds, a share of 100 per cent.

**The election timing share.** The figure the protection share produces is taken in full whenever the election is recorded, a share of 100 per cent.

**The account standing share.** The figure the election timing share produces is taken in full whatever charges stand on the pass account, a share of 100 per cent.

**The allowance.** No allowance is settled against the figure the account standing share produces.

**The schedule carry component.** No component is added for carrying an open instalment schedule into the following season.

**How the figures assemble.** The three shares act one after another, each on the figure the step before it produced, and never on the fee base a second time; the allowance is then settled against that figure and the schedule carry component is added to what remains; and the fee is rounded to the cent only once, on that final figure, which is never below zero.

### The determination worked through

Hypothetical inputs: an election recorded on a Granite Ridge Summit Pass, whose carry-forward fee is 129.00.

The fee base is 129.00. The protection share takes it in full, leaving 129.00. The election timing share acts on that figure and takes it in full, leaving 129.00. The account standing share acts on what the timing share produced and takes it in full, leaving 129.00. No allowance is settled against that figure and no component is added to it. Rounded to the cent once, on that final figure, the fee placed on the pass account is 129.00.
